This screen combines FinSight's three approved review engines — Accounting, Audit and Tax — into one run. Each engine still decides its own applicable rules exactly as it does on its own screen (framework-aware for Accounting, Act-era-aware for Tax); this screen does not add, remove, or change any rule logic. There is no SEBI / Listed Entity option here — see the sidebar's SEBI · Future Module label for why.
